articles.summary: Discover how Medcrypt’s Product Security Intelligence Platform (PSIP) helps medical device manufacturers quickly assess cybersecurity maturity, compare products against peers, and identify the highest-risk gaps in financial terms. Learn how PSIP turns complex security data into actionable insights to guide strategy, budgets, and buyer confidence.
articles.title: Introducing the Product Security Intelligence Platform (PSIP): A Smarter Way to Benchmark, Quantify, and Improve Medical Device Cybersecurity

articles.summary: A recent DOJ settlement highlights cybersecurity as part of the “state of the art” expected in medical devices. Learn what this means for manufacturers and key takeaways for product, security, and regulatory teams.
articles.title: DOJ Settlement Highlights Growing Cybersecurity Enforcement in Life Sciences
